FAQ

Questions? We have answers.

How long does it take to build a website?

It depends on the size of the project. A simple 1–3 page website is much quicker than a larger business site. We will give you a clear timeline before we start.

What do I need to give you to get started?

Your business name, logo (if you have one), a short description of your services and any photos or content you want to include. If you don’t have everything, we will guide you.

Will my website work on mobile phones?

Yes. Every website we build is mobile-responsive and tested on phones, tablets and computers.

Can you help with domain and hosting?

Yes, we can help you choose and set up a domain and hosting. Tell us your requirement and we will include it in your quote.

Do you offer support after launch?

Yes. We stay with you after launch for fixes, updates and growth support. Just message us on WhatsApp.

How do I pay and how do we start?

Message us on WhatsApp or fill in the form below. We discuss your requirement, share a clear quote, and start work once the details are confirmed.
